page_title: PAR 0-1 ROM | Parma v AS Roma 16/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.
90+3' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

90+2' Angelino (AS Roma) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked. The linesman makes the right call and AS Roma will have a corner.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
88' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

88' Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort. The referee points to the corner flag and AS Roma will take a corner.
86' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Zion Suzuki.
85' Pontus Almqvist (Parma) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
82' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Botond Balogh (Parma) was quite harsh and Daniele Chiffi didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
81' Substitution. Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) has come on for Lucas Gourna-Douath.
79' Simon Sohm (Parma) controls a great pass from Jacob Ondrejka on the edge of the box, steadies himself but his poor effort goes yards over the bar.
78' Claudio Ranieri has decided to make a change. Angelino (AS Roma) replaces Anass Salah-Eddine.
78' Eldor Shomurodov (AS Roma) does well to reach the lofted pass in the centre of the box, but doesn't make full contact and his header drifts well past the right post.
77' We are about to witness a substitution. Jacob Ondrejka (Parma) is replacing Adrian Bernabe Garcia.
76' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) works the corner short.
73' Drissa Camara (Parma) serves up a nice cross, but Mile Svilar punches the ball away.
69' A short pass finds Matias Soule (AS Roma) in acres of space on the edge of the box and he decides to go for glory. His efforts looks in for all the world but just creeps past the left post.
69' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
68' Anass Salah-Eddine (AS Roma) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. AS Roma have been awarded a corner kick.
66' Here is a change. Matteo Cancellieri is going off and Fabio Pecchia gives the last tactical orders to Mathias Lovik (Parma).
66' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Drissa Camara (Parma) is coming onto the pitch as Alessandro Vogliacco cannot continue after picking up an injury.
65' It's time for a substitution. Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) comes on in place of Alexis Saelemaekers.
65' The game is interrupted as Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma) is flagged offside.
63' Daniele Chiffi shows a yellow card to Lucas Gourna-Douath (AS Roma) for his blatant foul.
62' That's a well-taken pass by Matteo Cancellieri (Parma). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
61' Anass Salah-Eddine (AS Roma) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
57' The corner from Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) is intercepted by the defence.

57' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the bottom left corner. Zion Suzuki has a clear sight of it makes a comfortable save. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to AS Roma.
56' Simon Sohm (Parma) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Mile Svilar scrambling, but it flies just over the bar.
55' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Daniele Chiffi had an easy-decision to make.
52' Anass Salah-Eddine (AS Roma) is obviously very disappointed with his shot from the rebound. He aims exactly at the goalkeeper's gloves. This should have been an easy goal!
52' Matias Soule (AS Roma) receives a pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, Zion Suzuki makes a great save to stop his effort.
51' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
50' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The referee signals a corner kick to AS Roma.
47' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Mandela Keita (Parma) comes off for Pontus Almqvist.
46' Half-time substitution. Manu Kone (AS Roma) will not participate anymore and Lorenzo Pellegrini is coming on.
46' Claudio Ranieri makes a switch. Victor Nelsson is coming on in place of Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) at the start of the second period.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' Parma fail to score from a corner as Mile Svilar (AS Roma) leaps to collect the ball.

45+3' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The ball goes behind for a corner. Parma will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
45+2' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) tries his luck with a shot from long distance after receiving a good pass. His poorly placed effort flies miles wide of the left post.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass.
44' Matteo Cancellieri (Parma) was too forceful with his tackle and Daniele Chiffi interrupted the game to signal a free kick. AS Roma are awarded a free kick.
43' Alessandro Vogliacco (Parma) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
42' Alessandro Vogliacco (Parma) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
41' AS Roma keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
38' Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.
35' Dennis Man (Parma) must leave the pitch due to his teammate's red card and Botond Balogh comes onto the pitch.
34' Matias Soule (AS Roma) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
33' 0 - 1 Matias Soule (AS Roma) steps up to take a perfectly positioned free kick. He sends a sweet strike towards the top right corner, bouncing in off the post. Pure magic.
32' AS Roma have a free kick.
32' The ref makes the signal that the yellow is cancelled but immediately brandishes a straight red to Giovanni Leoni (Parma). He’s distraught but has to leave the field of play.
32' The AS Roma players are stunned as referee Daniele Chiffi changes his mind after a VAR review. NO PENALTY! Play to continue.
31' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for AS Roma as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
30' Giovanni Leoni (Parma) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
30' Giovanni Leoni (Parma) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement. The referee points to the penalty spot. PENALTY to AS Roma!
29' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) whips in a cross from the corner, but Zion Suzuki is well positioned and punches the ball away.
28' Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. AS Roma force their opponents to concede a corner.
28' AS Roma take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

28' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. AS Roma force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
27' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
25' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the bottom right corner, but Mile Svilar is equal to it and makes an easy save.
23' The foul by Matteo Cancellieri (Parma) was seen by Daniele Chiffi who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
22' The resulting corner from Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
22' The ball is cleared after Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to AS Roma.
20' Poor challenge! Matias Soule (AS Roma) is penalised for tripping and Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle.
18' Matias Soule (AS Roma) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
16' The defence just can't clear the ball and a rebound eventually falls to Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) deep inside the box, but his well-hit shot flies just wide of the left post.
14' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) will deliver the corner kick.

14' Anass Salah-Eddine (AS Roma) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The referee blows his whistle, AS Roma are awarded a corner kick.
14' Eldor Shomurodov (AS Roma) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
13' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) is able to continue to play.
12' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
11' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Daniele Chiffi blows for a foul.

9' Enrico Del Prato (Parma) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Daniele Chiffi blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
8' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
6' AS Roma are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
3' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Matias Soule, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball goes out of play and Parma will have a goal kick.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and AS Roma will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Daniele Chiffi.
